Create one landscape 3:2 Minecraft architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background, crisp vanilla voxel blocks only, for a Minecraft Java 1.21.1 public build catalog. Title: "FORT POINT / GOLDEN GATE SOUTH · 1937". No characters, animals or villagers. Three small whole-site thumbnail takes across the upper half, each recognisably the south end of Golden Gate Bridge over Fort Point, exploring block massing/arch bracing/arrangement within the SAME exact site envelope, not alternative landmarks. Show dark red-brown brick Civil War casemate fort at water's edge with three tiers of deeply recessed stepped arched gun ports, open paved courtyard with arcaded galleries, flat parapet and tiny dark iron lighthouse on northwest roof; above it the International Orange steel arch between paired pale Art Deco pylons, massive concrete south cable anchorage and long climbing-bluff approach viaduct. Show all four elements in each thumbnail, with one larger oblique northwest view, one elevated courtyard view and one long side elevation. Water is north and west, north low z, east high x, bridge along z. Small north arrow.

Middle/lower row: FOUR detailed voxel callouts with leader lines and clear labels: "CASEMATE ARCHES" showing three brick tiers and granite base; "ARCH + DECO PYLON" showing orange ribs, spandrels and pale fluted pylon; "LIGHTHOUSE + PARAPET" showing slender black iron lantern tower at northwest corner; "CABLE ANCHORAGE" showing steep orange cables entering pale concrete housings and recessed panels. Light recessed interiors with discreet lanterns and concealed sea_lantern blocks so no mob spawns.

Bottom: neatly aligned block swatch strip grouped by roles WALLS / TRIM / ROOF / WINDOWS / ACCENTS. Actual Minecraft texture cubes with exact legible IDs below each, use these 1.21.1 ids verbatim: WALLS: minecraft:bricks, minecraft:granite. TRIM: minecraft:polished_granite, minecraft:stone_bricks, minecraft:smooth_sandstone. ROOF: minecraft:stone_brick_slab. WINDOWS: minecraft:iron_bars, minecraft:black_stained_glass. ACCENTS: minecraft:red_terracotta, minecraft:orange_terracotta, minecraft:red_concrete, minecraft:orange_concrete, minecraft:chain, minecraft:lantern. Bridge steel predominantly red_terracotta/orange_terracotta with red_concrete/orange_concrete highlights; concrete pale gray/cream. Lighthouse dark iron represented with polished_blackstone_wall, iron_bars and black_stained_glass, lantern. Only existing vanilla 1.21.1 blocks, no pale oak or iron_chain. Architectural presentation with generous gutters, small tidy lettering, no photorealism, no smooth curved meshes: every arch and structural element visibly stepped voxel construction. This is a mood board, with precise coherent module relationships and recognizable site character.
reads: Dark red-brown brick Fort Point directly at the rocky water’s edge.
Three stacked rows of recessed arched casemate gun ports above a gray masonry base.
Open paved parade courtyard enclosed by brick galleries.
Flat barbette roof and low parapet with a slender black lighthouse and glowing lantern.
International Orange stepped steel arch spanning above the fort, with vertical spandrels and deck trusses.
Pale Art Deco concrete pylons with vertical fluting and stepped crowns.
Orange main cables descending into massive concrete anchorage housings with recessed panels.
Long orange approach viaduct on braced steel supports toward the bluff.
Role-grouped Minecraft block swatches beneath the site views and four detail callouts; generated with the built-in image tool and saved as moodboard.png.
